title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I want to take fatwa on the issue related to my sister married in Pakistan. Her husband died few months ago and he was working in a bank in Karachi. Now after his death the bank had given certain amount of money to my sister by saying that it is group Insurance money. But my brother in law never ever gave any amount no matter monthly, quarterly or yearly in the form of premium to the bank for this group insurance. The bank officials told that it is compulsory for all the employees working in that bank to take group insurance (which is provided free of cost by the bank to its employees) and the yearly premiums for that group insurance was being given by the bank and not by the employee. I will be highly grateful and thankful to you if can tell me (give fatwa) in the light of Islamic principles that the money is JAIEZ or HARAAM. Warm Regards? 3104 views Q. Dear Mufti sahib! my father deposited some money in the bank in 1997/98, at that time he doesn't know much about the interest, later on in 2008 he realized that extra money that bank will give to him is interest. so he decided to give the money to the deserved peoples. but my father died in august last year. i want to know. (1): that all the money of interest will be given to the deserved onces. or we are also able to keep some money of interest. because at the time of the deposit the value of the money was much greater than it is now. (2): if we are not able to keep the money, then to whom it may be given. (3): can we give it to our poor relatives, if they also know that the money we giving to them is the money of interest. 1964 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 43645 Country: India Title: Stamp duty with interest money Question: I own the house for which I paid stamp duty from my halal money when my father was alive but in the registration agreement we added our brother’s name as well. My father has passed away now and we divided all the assets according to Shariah. My question is now if I have to remove my brother’s name from the agreement then government is asking for stamp duty again. So can I pay the stamp duty from the bank interest money as I have already paid the stamp duty once from my halal money? Answer ID: 43645 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 202/166/H=1434) It is not lawful to pay stamp duty with interest money derived from bank. It is similar to spend interest on oneself, which is obviously incorrect. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
